falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically featured higher lows and contained drawdowns; a break below this level invalidates the structural support thesis and suggests the pattern match was coincidental, not predictive

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies moderate complacency, not panic; sustained elevated VIX contradicts the pattern's characteristic volatility compression and indicates a different regime (liquidation, not bottoming)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality of this magnitude signals systemic stress or recession pricing that overrides the bottoming pattern; the 2024 August bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising, not collapsing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
